craft_notes: Sthāyin: utsāha at willed-measure — tenderness (vatsa) inside rigor. Stations gained from contracted state; five attainders listed whole. Rejected: (a) trimming list → killed: five are the stations. Read aloud: NARR-owed IN-work, BE-ing … KNOW-er-HOOD-gained.

lines: Narrowed in work, being — that power follows him;
his Lord-of-Wisdom, Ever-Blest, Śiva-hoods — body, breath, mind, void, knowerhood gained.
l4.sanskrit_cite: mitavṛttis satī sā ca śaktis tam anuvartate | tasya vidyeśasādākhyaśivatās saṃkucatsthiteḥ

reads_against.argmap: What stations follow power? → Limited follows; stations attained from contracted state.
reads_against.c1_rasa: vīra of called bound; vīra of followed stations; adbhuta of teeming imagination; śānta of feast-abiding; vātsalya-vīra of bidden beholding; vīra of unothered means
